lines.english: Lena is ten years old.

lines.serbian: Posle škole igra igricu na računaru.
lines.croatian: Nakon škole igra igricu na računalu.
lines.english: After school she plays a game on the computer.

lines.serbian: U igrici je ona mali vitez.
lines.croatian: U igrici je ona mali vitez.
lines.english: In the game she's a little knight.

lines.serbian: Vitez mora da spase zamak od zmaja.
lines.croatian: Vitez mora spasiti dvorac od zmaja.
lines.english: The knight has to save the castle from a dragon.

lines.serbian: Lena je već na desetom nivou.
lines.croatian: Lena je već na desetoj razini.
lines.english: Lena is already on level ten.
The dragon is big and green.
Lena tries. She loses.
She tries again. She loses again.
"Lena, dinner!" calls Mum.
"Five more minutes!"

lines.serbian: Njen mali brat Vuk ulazi u sobu.
lines.croatian: Njezin mali brat Vuk ulazi u sobu.
lines.english: Her little brother Vuk comes into the room.
He looks at the screen.
"Why don't you use the sword?"
"What sword?"
"There, behind the tree."
Lena takes the sword. The dragon falls.
She's won!

lines.serbian: – Kako si to znao? Imaš samo šest godina!
lines.croatian: – Kako si to znao? Imaš samo šest godina!
lines.english: "How did you know that? You're only six!"

lines.serbian: – Igram ovo dok si ti u školi – kaže Vuk.
lines.croatian: – Igram ovo dok si ti u školi – kaže Vuk.
lines.english: "I play this while you're at school," says Vuk.

lines.serbian: Mama ih ponovo zove. Oboje trče na večeru.
lines.croatian: Mama ih ponovno zove. Oboje trče na večeru.
lines.english: Mum calls them again. They both run to dinner.
